events.body:
Before routing real transactional messages, you can use Resend to exercise three email event paths. Resend is a transactional email platform with dedicated test addresses for simulated outcomes.

Send one message to each address:

- delivered@resend.dev for delivered events
- bounced@resend.dev for bounced events
- complained@resend.dev for spam complaints

Then inspect the resulting events in the Resend Dashboard, Webhooks, or API—whichever interface your application will use. The test addresses do not affect your domain reputation.

This evaluation confirms which signals Resend exposes and lets you inspect your event-handling path. It does not predict production inbox placement or production deliverability.

Review the test-address documentation before implementing the flow.

events.subject: Test delivered, bounced, and complaint paths
events.preview_text: Exercise three email outcomes before sending to real recipients.
events.body:
Before routing transactional email to real recipients, you can use Resend test addresses to exercise delivered, bounced, and spam-complaint event paths.

Send one sample message in turn to delivered@resend.dev, bounced@resend.dev, and complained@resend.dev. Then inspect each result in the Resend Dashboard or through your webhook path. These simulated events do not affect your domain reputation.

Resend is a transactional email platform for developers, with test recipients designed for evaluating these paths before real messages enter the flow.

Review the documented Node.js test for the required Resend API key and verified domain, plus a complete HTML payload addressed to delivered@resend.dev. You can use that first send before substituting the bounce and complaint addresses.

This test exercises event handling. It does not establish production deliverability or inbox placement.

events.subject: Test three email event paths
events.preview_text: Simulate delivery, bounce, and complaint events before sending to real recipients.
events.body:
Resend provides test addresses for exercising email event paths without contacting real recipients or affecting domain reputation. Send one sample message to each address:

- delivered@resend.dev
- bounced@resend.dev
- complained@resend.dev

Then inspect the corresponding event in the Resend Dashboard or through your webhook path. This gives you a small, controlled check of delivered, bounced, and spam-complaint handling before routing transactional messages to real users.

The documented Node.js test includes a complete HTML payload for delivered@resend.dev. It also shows the prerequisites: a Resend API key and verified domain.

Review the Node.js test

This test exercises those event paths. It does not establish production deliverability or inbox placement.
